body:
**[comments] Rule 5, a call-site comment says only why here: shorten**

Five of the seven lines restate things the reader already has: the k_vnni::layout_on branch condition (Rule 2), the 'why VNNI' paragraph of Note [K VNNI storage] (Rule 5), the page_info contract in gof.hpp lines 61-66 (caller-owned, 64-byte-aligned scratch, one row per token: Rule 5), and the neighbouring v_head_fn (Rule 4, maps to no line of this body). The one fact this site needs is why get_k_row into dest replaces the page pointer of the else branch: a VNNI slot holds no contiguous K row (Note item 6, page::k is not available for VNNI slots).

Proposed:
```cpp
                        // A VNNI slot has no contiguous K row. Gather one into dest
                        // (Note [K VNNI storage] in kv_cache.hpp).
```
